body:
Second concrete block after the policy-shape repair: cand-0P564F15Z84PPTGX1XANS3A9VY is valid and on the right issue, but it reuses exact old commit OID 6ad95c5c. The reducer therefore treats every same-OID recut as mutual ancestry. Current `candidate show` has `ancestor_abandoned` for cand-56GP49... and `ancestor_pending` for cand-0PQX..., while the old row reciprocally sees the new row pending. This row cannot become landable by adding reviews/evidence/authorization.

Smallest safe repair: create a NEW commit on frozen/current main 10b0353764bc3db9d17790d828052448b80b237f whose two-path patch is byte-identical to 6ad95c5c, then propose that new OID under bd-01M1C5KCPBXA2NNC2KV89FW76F. Preserve exactly the two paths and named reviewers; add only `chief-merged-tree-gate` as an extra requirement so implicit ancestry appears once; name me authorizer. Before routing reviews, confirm `candidate show` has no ancestor_pending/ancestor_abandoned reason codes. Do not recut 6ad95c5c itself again.
